visualCharacteristics: Testimonial switcher: one large active panel showing a portrait image beside a name, role, and quote, with a row of avatar+name tab buttons below that switch the active testimonial. Panel is two-column on desktop and stacks on mobile; tab row is a 4-up grid.
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row's first cell is the tab label (avatar + name), remaining cells are the testimonial panel (image, name, role, quote).
usage: Rotating set of customer/community testimonials selectable via avatar tabs.
